records.name: Finishing Blow
records.skill_description: A fast close-range Strike Super that performs an energy-infused chop and can re-stand the opponent, allowing immediate follow-up attacks.
records.mechanics_notes: The move can rapidly close distance when the opponent is nearby or has been knocked back, then perform a single chop that re-stands the target. It can be canceled into movement, basic attacks, or other skills after a successful hit; exact frame behavior is version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: Whis's mentor training rewards include Finishing Blow, followed by Prelude to Destruction, Strike of Revelation, and Symphonic Destruction. Independent mentor documentation confirms the same reward sequence.
records.pve_notes: Mentor training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast re-stand/teleport-style Strike Super suitable for extending combos. Detailed frame and matchup claims are intentionally not encoded as fixed numeric data.
